text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Silence Suzuka's running style is unlike any
seen before... And the
more we train, the
more we understand it.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh... She's going even faster than
before.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
She's running medium-distance like it's a
mile! Suzuka really is
amazing!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff... Ngh...

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Should we take a break? Let me know if
I'm going too hard on you.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Should we take a break? Let me know if
I'm going too hard on you.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Thanks... But I'm fine. The fun I'm having
outweighs the fatigue.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Despite the sweat dripping down her face, Silence Suzuka is still beaming. That positive attitude of hers shows in her running.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her abilities are already incredible... Just
what sort of running will
come about if we
continue down this path?

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
You've got a lot of talent, but it's a little
unrefined. If we polish it
juuust right, we'll
have ourselves a diamond.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
You've got a lot of talent, but it's a little
unrefined. If we polish it
juuust right, we'll
have ourselves a diamond.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
But if we want to reach for the clouds, we
need to make sure the
foundation is solid.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
But if we want to reach for the clouds, we
need to make sure the
foundation is solid.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
A solid foundation... Okay, I understand.
I'll take a short break.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Right!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
From this, we can determine that ramp
training builds muscle in the
quadriceps,
leading to explosive power...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Haven't seen you in the library for a long
time. Did your trainer tell
you to do some
research?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
No, I'm just looking into effective training
methods to help improve
my ability even
more.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
My trainer's doing a wonderful job, so it's
not like I'm worried. I just
don't like
standing still.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Sounds like you found the perfect
team for you.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
And it really shows in your racing. No one
would even dream of
winning a race
running like you do.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
If it were any other racer, I'd caution you
against your current style.
But I have a
feeling you'll be able to master that
otherworldly running
of yours.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I know I will. After all, the scenery
down that path is calling me.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I'm pretty excited myself. I want to see
that fantastical running of
yours, but I also
can't wait to beat it with my own.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Hehe, I'm sure you'll have the chance.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Suzuka!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Fukukitaru?! What are you wearing?!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Don't tell me... Is this your newest
good-luck outfit?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Not at all! I was doing some physical
therapy in the pool!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
That's right, you were injured during
training, weren't you?
Unfortunate as it
may be, at least it didn't happen during a
race.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Agreed. When I try to imagine such a
scenario, I get chills... All hail
the great
Shiraoki for preventing such a grave
situation! Thank
youuu...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Wait, that's not why I'm here! I just heard
some dreadful news, so I
came here as fast
as I could!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Suzuka, is it true that your next race is the
Kinko Sho?!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Y-yes, that's correct...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Hnngh! To think I'd be up against a soaring
eagle like you in my great
return to racing!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Just as I was feeling good about my future,
I receive this most
devastating news. Don't
tell me... Disaster approaches!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
You could be that disaster, Fukukitaru. I
saw you win the Kikuka Sho.
You were
amazing.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Agreed. That sprint in the homestretch was
magnificent. Have some
confidence.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Hrrrm... Perhaps I am overreacting. There's no telling how this race will unfold.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Yeah, you're right! I'm a G1 title holder! Others might count me out, but guess what? I've got what it takes to win despite my hiatus!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, I'm looking forward to it.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Ooohhh! That smile has me scared all over
again! I knew it, a great
misfortune awaits!
Shiraokiiiiii!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Oh, for—shut up and go back to the pool
already!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Think we'll see Silence Suzuka outrun the
rest of the racers today?

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Are you kidding? Have you seen this
lineup? No way it's gonna be
that easy!

text_block_list.name: Fan C
text_block_list.text:
Well, I think she can do it! Show us that
amazing running of yours,
Suzuka!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Inhale... exhale...

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
We cranked up the intensity of your
training, but you took it in stride.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Thinking about the scenery I'll see after all
this hard work made any
fatigue I had just
disappear.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Every day is such a joy. I can feel myself
running towards my dreams.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
I feel the same way. I wake up every
morning wondering just how
much you'll
grow today.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Then I suppose I'll have to show you in
today's race. I promise that I
won't let
anyone else take the lead.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I will!
